title: haex-hive Workflow Registry v1 (Spec 011)
description: Schema for `.specify/workflows/workflow-registry.json`. The `active_workflow` field is the load-bearing new addition in Spec 011: readers of the constitution's 'Declared speckit workflow adherence' bullet dereference it to determine which workflow.yml is binding. Top-level keys are strictly enumerated (typos refused); per-workflow entries accept unknown fields for forward compat with speckit-community metadata.

active_workflow.description: Names an entry in `workflows` (the bundled `speckit` id, or an adopted-atom id). When null or absent, the reader falls back to the bundled `speckit` workflow.

workflows.description: At minimum contains the bundled `speckit` workflow. Additional entries land when workflow atoms are adopted.

version.description: Semantic version of the workflow using the complete SemVer 2.0.0 grammar, including optional prerelease and build metadata.

source.description: `bundled` for the built-in workflow that ships with haex-hive; `atom` for workflows adopted via `.haex-hive.json`.

atom_id.description: Reverse-DNS atom id. Required when `source` is `atom`; forbidden when `source` is `bundled`.

atom_revision.description: Full 40-char git SHA the atom was resolved at, per Principle IV. Required when `source` is `atom`.

installed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of first install.

updated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of last update.
